title: Was it lead poisoning? The Franklin mystery #FranklinExpedition
subtitle: Frozen Passage · Short 6/6
caption:
For years, lead from tinned food was blamed for the deaths of Franklin's men. Later research told a more complicated story – including a 2016 thumbnail study pointing to zinc deficiency and tuberculosis.
